core.title: Medium Duty Brass Padlock With 3/8 Shackle, Mul-T-Lock G55G1

text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock G55G1 3/8" Diameter Shackle Brass Padlock

The G-series Padlocks from Mul-T-Lock are a medium security solution that offers great value for money. This brass body padlock is anti-corrosive in all weather conditions and its 3/8" hardened boron alloy shackle make it tamper resistant. This, with the incorporate Mul-T-Lock High Security lock cylinder make it a good choice for general home, industrial and commercial use.

MUL-T-LOCK's high security lock cylinders are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card per key combination and 2 keys per lock cylinder.

Also available: 3/8" Diameter Protected Shackle Padlock

The shackle is locked with a double ball bearing mechanism. 90 degree key rotation unlocks the padlock.

Features for Mul-T-Lock G55G1 Brass Padlock

  • 3/8" Diameter Hardened Boron Alloy Shackle
  • High Corrosion Resistant Brass Padlock Body
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206SP Security Keyway
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock G55G1 Brass Padlock

  • Shackle Diameter: 3/8" (10mm)
  • Padlock Body Height: 2-1/8" (54mm)
  • Padlock Body Width: 2-1/8" (54mm)
  • Padlock Body Thickness: 7/8" (21mm)
  • Clearance: 1-1/16" (27mm)
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Supplied with 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK G55G1 Padlock Specifications Diagram (PDF)

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Keys Cut below if more than the standard 2 keys are required.
